zh.title: 空中巴士與澳洲航空A350-1000ULR完成兩趟測試飛行
zh.summary: 根據航空媒體Simple Flying報導，空中巴士與澳洲航空的新款A350-1000ULR客機已執行測試飛行，在兩趟測試中累計飛行達43小時。其中一趟測試飛行於7月23日自空中巴士位於土魯斯的設施起飛。該型機未來預計用於連接澳洲東部與歐洲及紐約。
body: 根據航空媒體 Simple Flying 的報導，空中巴士（Airbus）與澳洲航空（Qantas）合作針對新款 A350-1000ULR 廣體客機展開測試飛行作業。公開的測試紀錄顯示，該款客機在合計兩趟的測試飛行任務中，累計總飛行時間已達 43 小時。
在相關測試環節中，其中一趟測試飛行於 7 月 23 日從空中巴士位於土魯斯（Toulouse）的生產與測試設施正式起飛。這款全新的 A350-1000ULR 客機未來預計將投入實際營運，專門用於連接澳洲東部地區與歐洲及紐約等超長程國際航線。

en.title: Qantas and Airbus A350-1000ULR Complete 43 Hours Across Two Test Flights
en.summary: According to news reported by Simple Flying, Airbus and Qantas have operated test flights involving the new Airbus A350-1000ULR aircraft. The aircraft recorded a total of 43 flight hours across two separate test flights during the testing phase. One of these test flights successfully took off from Airbus's facilities located at Toulouse on July 23. The new A350-1000ULR jet is eventually intended to be used by the airline to link eastern Australia directly with long-haul routes to Europe and New York.
body: According to Simple Flying, Airbus and Qantas have completed test flights using the new Airbus A350-1000ULR aircraft. Flight records show that the aircraft logged a total of 43 hours across two test flights. As part of the test campaign, one of the test flights departed from Airbus's facilities at Toulouse on July 23.

The long-range A350-1000ULR variant is currently being developed with the expectation that it will eventually be deployed on ultra-long-haul routes. The aircraft is slated to be used to link eastern Australia with major international destinations, specifically Europe and New York.
